name: Scientific Improvisation
description: By spending 1 action point and a full-round action, the Field Scientist combines common objects with a Craft check (DC 5 + the purchase DC of the closest matching object) to build a tool or device that functions for a number of rounds equal to his class level, or until the encounter ends, before breaking down.
